    Karavela Station, Evagora Pallikaride (Kennedy Square), Gladstonos, Apostolou Pavlou Avenue, Kings Avenue Mall, Tombs Of The Kings Station.

    Monday - Sunday:


    From Karavela:

    06:05, 06:20, 07:30, 08:00, 08:30 - 11:15 (every 15 minutes), 12:15 - 13:00 (every 15 minutes), 13:30, 14:00 - 19:30 (every 15 minutes), 20:00, 20:45, 21:15, 21:45 - 00:30 (every 30 minutes)


    From Tombs of The Kings:

    07:45, 08:15 - 11:15 (every 15 minutes), 12:00, 12:30 - 13:15 (every 15 minutes), 13:45, 14:15 - 19:15 (every 15 minutes), 19:45, 20:30, 21:00, 21:30 - 00:45 (every 30 minutes)
